polyrhythmicRelevance.description: In polyrhythmic LOOPs like the 3:4 example (D-Σ-P-M-Y-D-J-Θ-M-P-W-J)
observations: Beat pairs often follow alphaBetaCounterpart patterns
D to J and Σ to Θ relationships repeat at the polyrhythmic interval
Spatial placements (section transitions) may follow Period 4
